summary: Entra Policy Suite now runs in your own Azure, with a web app your admins sign in to.

new.title: Install in two lines
new.text: Install from PowerShell 7 or Azure Cloud Shell with a browser sign-in and no add-ons. You can preview the plan, a stopped install resumes, and every feature starts switched off.

new.title: User and device tagging with preview
new.text: Tag users and devices with rules, preview every run before it applies, and import your v1 rule files. Tamper alerts you to tag changes the suite did not make.

new.title: Conditional Access templates and review
new.text: Compare your policies with the template library, adopt or release them, and export documentation. The suite never writes a Conditional Access policy.

new.title: CA Policy Analyzer and Identity report
new.text: The analyzer groups policies by persona and monitors them, with alerts per persona. The Identity report shows gaps and downloads as a workbook.

new.title: Hybrid worker, roles and audit
new.text: A hybrid worker handles users synced from on-premises AD. SuperAdmin, Admin and Reader roles control access, and every change is audited.
